verdict: One locked shot through three eras, and the windows, table and fireplace stay put through both moves. Two flaws: the ruin has a fourth window that the depth map doesn't, and the wallpaper breaks up in hard-edged shapes for a moment in the second move. We checked the score by measurement only: no person has listened to it for this review.
peak_note: Peak is this run's own ComfyUI and tools, read from nvidia-smi every 2 seconds. The card was shared with other work. Time adds up each stage's own work, not the wait for the shared card.
